title: A certified sixteen-prime-factor lower bound for Lehmer's totient problem - research revision

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
The existing sixteen-factor lower bound and companion results are retained. A new self-contained appendix proves termination and completeness of a finite construction for every prescribed factor count k. It does not prove that all those outputs are empty; the full Lehmer conjecture remains open.

Verification: The repository contains partial Lean results for statements not depending on the exhaustive search. The full searches and the full Lehmer conjecture are not claimed to be Lean-formalised. The new uniform construction has a written proof and fresh exact controls; it is not Lean-formalized. The guarded k=14 run is explicitly incomplete.

Full requested closure: not established. New written research material awaits author review. Existing authorship and source credit are preserved. This is a research archive, not journal acceptance or a new independent zero-free theorem.
notes: The package includes exact source archives, proof/attempt notes and scoped verification records. Component licences remain authoritative. No new full-conjecture closure is claimed.
